connector.name: Mikrotik MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for MikroTik routers: firewall, NAT, routing, DHCP, DNS, WireGuard and more via SSH.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-server-mikrotik. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jeff-nasseri account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MIKROTIK_HOST
env.description: IP address or hostname of the MikroTik router

env.name: MIKROTIK_USERNAME
env.description: SSH username for the MikroTik router (default: admin)

env.name: MIKROTIK_PASSWORD
env.description: SSH password for the MikroTik router

env.name: MIKROTIK_PORT
env.description: SSH port of the MikroTik router (default: 22)

env.name: MIKROTIK_KEY_FILENAME
env.description: Path to SSH private key file for key-based authentication
